projects.description: Automated uptime, latency, and SLA monitoring daemon with webhook alerting and SQLite incident metrics.
High-performance CLI utility for auditing YAML/JSON configuration files, identifying CVE misconfigurations, and generating compliance scorecards.
End-to-end incident management and task orchestration portal featuring FastAPI REST backend, SQLite persistence, and responsive interactive web UI.
High-performance CLI utility for auditing YAML/JSON configuration files, identifying CVE misconfigurations, and generating compliance scorecards.
Production-ready semantic RAG context engine with dynamic chunk re-ranking, token budget optimizer, and citation verification.

An automated database schema drift detection and live migration workbench that inspects SQLite and SQLAlchemy models, calculates structural differences, and provides a real-time web portal to generate and test deterministic rollback migrations.

An intelligent log anomaly detection and root-cause analysis engine that ingests unstructured application logs, parses them into structured Pydantic models using regex-pattern learning, and exposes a high-performance FastAPI/Rich CLI suite to instantly isolate stack traces, recurring system errors, and performance bottlenecks.

A production-ready LLM proxy gateway and safety orchestrator that enforces security guardrails, semantic prompt caching, and structured output validation. It intercepts LLM API calls to sanitize PII, block prompt injections, serve instant cached responses for semantically equivalent queries, and guarantee schema compliance.

A high-performance webhook orchestration platform and developer portal that ingests, verifies, transforms, and reliably dispatches third-party event streams. It pairs an asynchronous FastAPI backend with a real-time React/TypeScript control plane to provide deep traffic inspection, custom payload reshaping, and resilient delivery retry mechanisms.

An embedded, DuckDB-powered dataset profiling and automated statistical drift detection engine. It ingests Parquet, CSV, and JSON data streams to compute distribution shifts, enforce schema contracts, and render interactive exploratory dashboards.

A production-grade ML inference monitoring and concept drift isolation engine. It intercepts live Scikit-Learn model prediction payloads, calculates statistical feature drift against baseline training distributions, and provides dynamic fallback model routing with diagnostic attributions via FastAPI and CLI interfaces.

An automated upstream dependency release monitoring and breaking-change impact engine. It continuously polls and scrapes package registries, GitHub releases, and documentation feeds to detect version updates, parse breaking-change notes, and evaluate impact against local project manifests.

A full-stack asynchronous queue observability and dead-letter queue (DLQ) triage platform that intercepts, visualizes, and safely replays failed background tasks. It combines a FastAPI REST backend and SQLite/SQLAlchemy data store with an interactive web workbench to perform raw payload mutation, stack-trace root cause tagging, and rate-limited replay execution.

An automated SQL query execution planner and regression testing utility that intercepts application database queries, analyzes query execution plans via EXPLAIN, and detects performance regressions or missing index opportunities against a local SQLite baseline.

ToolForge Runtime is an agentic middleware and execution sandboxing engine that validates, dry-runs, and safely executes LLM tool calls. It intercepts structured tool invocation requests, validates inputs against dynamically compiled Pydantic schemas, evaluates execution safety policies, and automatically triggers fallback tool chains when APIs fail or return malformed outputs.

An automated API contract evolution and backward-compatibility governance suite that inspects OpenAPI specifications, tracks breaking schema mutations across git branches, and provides an interactive web dashboard for real-time diff analysis. It ensures seamless microservice versioning by generating automated regression tests and compatibility matrices before deployment.

A declarative data cleaning and quality orchestration engine that transforms raw datasets into audit-ready assets using YAML-defined constraint policies. It automatically applies remediation logic, computes statistical impact scores, and generates a detailed mutation manifest to ensure reproducibility in high-stakes analytics.

An adaptive contextual recommendation engine that combines unsupervised feature clustering with contextual multi-armed bandits to deliver personalized content, pricing tiers, or API action routing in real time. It continuously ingests high-dimensional user interaction payloads, groups context vectors into dynamic micro-segments, and optimizes online conversion rates with automatic cold-start handling and delayed reward feedback loops.
